source: Embedded V1 MLB-centered scouting reference model
source_detail: Fixed reference means plus explicit guideline spread parameters used for automatic Present grades. No live download required.

hb_validation.method: fixed internal convention; R/L manual TrackMan input normalized by throws

grade_rule: Reference mean = 50; 0.5 guideline SD = 5 grade points; 1 guideline SD = 10 grade points; rounded to scouting increments.
